title: Grain Is Getting Cheaper Because It Cannot Leave
subtitle: With the Sea of Azov closed and Black Sea shipping under attack, Russian wheat and barley prices fell against last year both at home and at the export gate.

source.name: Russian domestic and Novorossiysk export grain price series

data.label: Wheat, domestic market
data.annotation: Down 8.6% to 8.9% year over year by 26 July.

data.label: Barley, export
data.annotation: 13,000 rubles per ton, the sharpest fall of the three.

supportingFacts.label: Added cost of moving grain overland to Black Sea ports, with such transport 27.4% dearer than last year.

metadata.keyFinding: Barley export prices fell 12.2% year over year as export routes closed.
